Corollary
[The isometry group is preserved under Ricci flow] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0233 ↗ thm:chow-iii-backward-uniqueness 1. ch22:22.21\group Uniqueness

For a complete bounded-curvature Ricci flow, \[ \operatorname {Isom}(g(t))=\operatorname {Isom}(g(0)) \] for every $t>0$.
Proof

\sketch Backward uniqueness gives $\operatorname {Isom}(g(t))\subseteq \operatorname {Isom}(g(0))$; forward uniqueness gives the reverse inclusion.

□
